name: dsh-control
description: Let Codex supervise bounded tasks on the local DeepSeek Harness Desktop session through a fixed tool set.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate tasks to local DeepSeek Harness
interface.longDescription: Codex keeps planning and acceptance. The plugin exposes thirteen fixed tools that start, supervise, answer and cancel bounded DeepSeek Harness runs, and reports the durable Markdown report for every run. Native sessions remain owned by DeepSeek Harness.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check the local DeepSeek Harness bridge status with dsh_doctor, then delegate one bounded read-only task.
